job: Swims through every word in a GitHub account's repos, public and (with a token for the account) private, and flags document-control, blatant, organizational and systemic errors.
runs_on: Any modern browser (index.html). Optional command line: Node 20 or newer.
built_with: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5), 2026-10-07; browser interface and naming corrections prepared with Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-08; private-repo support added with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-09; OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-11; Flash Audit repairs by OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-14
implementation_status: The canonical and dated browser entries share the auditor (public repos always; private repos too when the token belongs to the audited account) and explicit repo-scoped naming corrections. Rules stay in browser storage or a private CLI file; tokens stay only in memory. Private snapshots can be audited locally. There is no automatic learning or background monitoring. Original sprite.json is unchanged.
desktop_art_built_with: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), built-in imagegen and native renderer, 2026-10-11

audit.subject: GitHub repositories and Pet Program conformance
audit.needs: owner-approved account access when private repositories are included

tools.name: document-control-error
tools.intended_use: Required documents, headings and uncontrolled copies.

tools.name: blatant-error
tools.intended_use: Typos, placeholders, encoding and prohibited text.

tools.name: link-error
tools.intended_use: Repository paths, anchors and known GitHub links; no live external-site probes.

tools.name: secret-exposure-error
tools.intended_use: Recognizable secret patterns and sensitive filenames; not a full security scan.

tools.name: pet-metadata-error
tools.intended_use: Pet identity, required metadata and declared entry paths.

tools.name: tool-definition-error
tools.intended_use: Malformed tool lists, duplicate tool names and missing versions.

tools.name: release-metadata-error
tools.intended_use: Missing or inconsistent declared release versions; no deployed-release verification.

tools.name: scan-coverage-error
tools.intended_use: Unreadable files, incomplete trees and collector limitations.

tools.name: flash-audit
tools.intended_use: Manual audit instructions and read-only local metadata preflight; runtime and visual acceptance require evidence

tools.name: play-with-github-goldfish
tools.intended_use: Learn to use GitHub Aquarium in L3 chat

tools.name: care-for-github-goldfish
tools.intended_use: Learn to maintain GitHub Aquarium in L3 chat

tools.name: findastra-README-auditor
tools.intended_use: Owner-triggered profile audit, L3 rewrite and separate review, then an approved branch push and pull request for findastra/findastra/README.md.

framework_limitations: tool OFF is local execution control, not protected-core enforcement
no signed release or OS isolation
general browser chat and tutorials are separate; only the local README workflow connects to Codex L3

clicker_training.status: desktop triple-click and local maker/checker verified 2026-10-15
